as_told.title: Aztec crash site visit with splintered trees

plain: Many people say a craft that was not human crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says researchers Scott and Suzanne Ramsey spent more than $600,000 over decades looking into it and gathered a lot of evidence, and that he visited the crash site with them. In another episode he says he went to Aztec with his editor and does not mention the Ramseys.
